title: [v3-3-test] UI: Fix raw translation key showing as a Backfills column header
body:
Backport of #72836 to `v3-3-test`.

Cherry-picked from 5d559174c34692c61078449719136f754480cf82.

Scope-narrowed: the original PR also changed `BackfillDagRunsModal.tsx`, but that file does not exist on `v3-3-test` (it was introduced by #70159 "Show backfill Dag runs in the UI", which is not in 3.3). Only the `Backfills.tsx` fix applies — the same bug is present there (its column headers read `components:backfill.*` keys while `useTranslation()` declared no namespace). The merge also pulled in a main-only `useDurationFormat()` line adjacent to the change, which was dropped as it is unrelated to this PR and not present in 3.3.
